title: Feed delivery
description: The core's delivery to a module of the core events its describe subscribes to, from projects the module is switched on for. Events arrive in sequence order and at least once, so a module reacts to an event it has seen before as it did the first time. A flow run's ended or stopped event is delivered only after the core's worker for that flow run has returned and after the core has called stop on any dispatch the stopped flow run still held, so nothing the core runs for the flow run is still running in its work path when the module receives it. Each event carries ids only; the module pulls anything else through the core's query API. A feed delivery has no answer document.

events.description: The events delivered, in sequence order.

event.description: One core event, of one of the kinds describe can subscribe to.

parcelEntered.description: A parcel entered a stage, by being created in it or moved into it.

flowRunEnded.description: A flow run reached the end of its flow. Delivered only once the core's worker for the flow run has returned.

flowRunStopped.description: Someone stopped a live flow run before its end. Delivered only once the core's worker for the flow run has returned and the core has called stop on any dispatch the flow run held.

flowRunPaused.description: A flow run stopped to wait for a person.

parcelFieldSet.description: A value was recorded in one of a parcel's fields.

field.description: The name of the field that was set.

project.description: The project the event happened in, so the module resolves the project's settings and credential profile.

sequence.description: The event's position in the node's event sequence. The core keeps the module's position by it, and a module that sees a sequence it has already handled is seeing a redelivery.
